    Rick Pitino
     is the head men's basketball coach at St. John's University, hired on March 20, 2023, as the 22nd coach in program history. A Hall of Famer, Pitino has led the 2025-26 Red Storm to the Sweet 16. His staff includes Associate Head Coach Steve Masiello and assistant coaches Ricky Johns, Taliek Brown, and Bob Walsh. 
    This video shows Rick Pitino discussing his team's success and legacy:
    43s
    SNY
    YouTube• Mar 23, 2026
    Key Details About Rick Pitino at St. John's: 
    • Turnaround: Pitino is recognized for rapidly rebuilding the St. John's program, leading them to the 2026 NCAA Tournament Sweet 16, notes this Instagram post.
    • Coaching Staff:
      The staff features several coaches who previously worked with Pitino at Iona, says this St. John\'s University Athletics article.
    • Experience: Pitino is a two-time NCAA National Champion and has taken five different schools to the Sweet 16 over five decades, notes this USA Today article.
    • Awards: He was named the 2025 BIG EAST Coach of the Year, according to this Facebook post. 
    Women's Basketball Coach 
    • Joe Tartamella is the head coach for the St. John's women's basketball team, per this St. John\'s University Athletics page.

    AI Overview
    Rick Pitino was hired as the head basketball coach at St. John's University on
    March 20, 2023. As of March 2026, he has just completed his third season (2023-2026) with the Red Storm, signing a six-year deal to lead the program. 
    Key details of his tenure include: 
    • Rapid Success: In his first two seasons, he turned a struggling program around, leading them to consecutive 20-win seasons, consecutive Big East Tournament appearances, and back-to-back Big East regular season/tournament championships in 2025 and 2026.
    • Contract: He signed a six-year contract upon his arrival from Iona College.
    • Result: As of March 2026, Pitino has been at St. John's for three full seasons.
